<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL" id="Definitions_TreeHouse" targetNamespace="http://example.com/bpmn/treehouse">
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_Requirements" name="Requirements"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_Draft" name="Draft plan"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_AdditionalRequirements" name="Additional requirements"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_RevisedDraft" name="Revised draft"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_MaterialOrder" name="Material order"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_MaterialsDelivered" name="Materials delivered"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_BuildRequest" name="Build request"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_PartyInvitation" name="Party invitation"/>

  <bpmn:collaboration id="Collab_TreeHouse">
    <bpmn:participant id="Part_You" name="You" processRef="Process_You"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Part_Architect" name="Tree house architect"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Part_OnlineStores" name="Online stores"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Part_Friends" name="Friends"/>

    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_Requirements" name="Requirements" sourceRef="SendTask_SendRequirements" targetRef="Part_Architect" messageRef="Msg_Requirements"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_Draft" name="Draft plan" sourceRef="Part_Architect" targetRef="ReceiveTask_ReceiveDraft" messageRef="Msg_Draft"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_AdditionalRequirements" name="Additional requirements" sourceRef="SendTask_SendAdditional" targetRef="Part_Architect" messageRef="Msg_AdditionalRequirements"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_RevisedDraft" name="Revised draft" sourceRef="Part_Architect" targetRef="ReceiveTask_ReceiveRevised" messageRef="Msg_RevisedDraft"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_MaterialOrder" name="Material order" sourceRef="SendTask_OrderMaterials" targetRef="Part_OnlineStores" messageRef="Msg_MaterialOrder"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_MaterialsDelivered" name="Materials delivered" sourceRef="Part_OnlineStores" targetRef="IntermediateCatch_MaterialsDelivered" messageRef="Msg_MaterialsDelivered"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_BuildRequest" name="Build request" sourceRef="SendTask_RequestFriends" targetRef="Part_Friends" messageRef="Msg_BuildRequest"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_PartyInvitation" name="Party invitation" sourceRef="SendTask_SendInvitations" targetRef="Part_Friends" messageRef="Msg_PartyInvitation"/>
  </bpmn:collaboration>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_You" name="Building a tree house" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_TreeHouseProject" name="Decide to build tree house"/>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_CollectRequirements" name="Collect requirements"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="SendTask_SendRequirements" name="Send requirements to architect" messageRef="Msg_Requirements"/>
    <bpmn:receiveTask id="ReceiveTask_ReceiveDraft" name="Receive draft from architect" messageRef="Msg_Draft"/>

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Refine_Merge" name="Draft received"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Refine_Split" name="Further refinement needed?" default="Flow_PlanApproved"/>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_SpecifyAdditional" name="Specify additional requirements"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="SendTask_SendAdditional" name="Send additional requirements to architect" messageRef="Msg_AdditionalRequirements"/>
    <bpmn:receiveTask id="ReceiveTask_ReceiveRevised" name="Receive revised draft" messageRef="Msg_RevisedDraft"/>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_CreateMaterialList" name="Create list of needed materials from plan"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="SendTask_OrderMaterials" name="Order materials from online stores" messageRef="Msg_MaterialOrder"/>

    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_Order_Split" name="Order processing"/>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="IntermediateCatch_MaterialsDelivered" name="Materials delivered">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MED_MaterialsDelivered" messageRef="Msg_MaterialsDelivered"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="SendTask_RequestFriends" name="Send build requests to friends" messageRef="Msg_BuildRequest"/>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_Order_Join" name="Materials delivered and friends asked"/>

    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="IntermediateCatch_HouseBuilt" name="House is built"/>

    <bpmn:sendTask id="SendTask_SendInvitations" name="Send party invitations to friends" messageRef="Msg_PartyInvitation"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_CreateAttendeeList" name="Create list of attending people"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_BuySnacks" name="Buy snacks for party"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_PartyPrepared" name="Party prepared"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_01" sourceRef="Start_TreeHouseProject" targetRef="Task_CollectRequirements"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_02" sourceRef="Task_CollectRequirements" targetRef="SendTask_SendRequirements"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_03" sourceRef="SendTask_SendRequirements" targetRef="ReceiveTask_ReceiveDraft"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_04" sourceRef="ReceiveTask_ReceiveDraft" targetRef="Gateway_Refine_Merge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_05" sourceRef="Gateway_Refine_Merge" targetRef="Gateway_Refine_Split"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_MoreRefinement" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_Refine_Split" targetRef="Task_SpecifyAdditional"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_06" sourceRef="Task_SpecifyAdditional" targetRef="SendTask_SendAdditional"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_07" sourceRef="SendTask_SendAdditional" targetRef="ReceiveTask_ReceiveRevised"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_08" sourceRef="ReceiveTask_ReceiveRevised" targetRef="Gateway_Refine_Merge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_PlanApproved" name="No" sourceRef="Gateway_Refine_Split" targetRef="Task_CreateMaterialList"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_09" sourceRef="Task_CreateMaterialList" targetRef="SendTask_OrderMaterials"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_10" sourceRef="SendTask_OrderMaterials" targetRef="Gateway_Order_Split"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_11" sourceRef="Gateway_Order_Split" targetRef="IntermediateCatch_MaterialsDelivered"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_12" sourceRef="Gateway_Order_Split" targetRef="SendTask_RequestFriends"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_13" sourceRef="IntermediateCatch_MaterialsDelivered" targetRef="Gateway_Order_Join"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_14" sourceRef="SendTask_RequestFriends" targetRef="Gateway_Order_Join"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_15" sourceRef="Gateway_Order_Join" targetRef="IntermediateCatch_HouseBuilt"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_16" sourceRef="IntermediateCatch_HouseBuilt" targetRef="SendTask_SendInvitations"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_17" sourceRef="SendTask_SendInvitations" targetRef="Task_CreateAttendeeList"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_18" sourceRef="Task_CreateAttendeeList" targetRef="Task_BuySnacks"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_19" sourceRef="Task_BuySnacks" targetRef="End_PartyPrepared"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
